body:
I had ran out of my Klonopin 2 weeks early, due to leaving them in a hotel room while on business. Surprise, surprise, when I called they were nowhere to be found. I take klonopin 0.5 mg BID, and was on my 3rd day without it.  I was going thru hell. I suddenly remember a friend who gets diclazepam shipped international to the US. I called him up and he gave me 10 of the 2mg tabs. They were pink and white, hard pressed.  In my severe state of benzo withdrawal, I took one.
+0:00 - Ingested 2 mg tablet, hoping it would ease the symptoms
+0:30 - No noticeable effects.  I take another 2 mg tablet
+1:30 - small noticeable effects now, kinda just relaxed and chill.  Nothing as strong as my regular klonopin would do at the time, though.
+3:45 - ok, maybe that second pill was a bit much. I like to consider myself experienced, having been on the 'scene' for 12 years.  However, I got incredibly groggy and simply had to go to sleep.
+18:30 - I awoke, still feeling incredibly groggy.
+18:30 - I awoke, still feeling incredibly groggy.
However, the w/d symptoms were totally GONE!  This was incredible!
Next day:
The withdrawal effect is still gone, and I feel somewhat lighter, but this may be due to the uncomfortable muscle tightening caused by k-pin withdrawal.  I get my next refill in a few days.  I think I may order some more of these to stop the sickness associated w/ cold turkey w/d.
[Other medication reported at time of report submission: 'Effexor XR  Propranolol Lisnopril']
